Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Kyle Kuzma?

Kyle Kuzma is 31 years old.

Where was Kyle Kuzma born?

Kyle Kuzma was born in Flint, Michigan.

When was Kyle Kuzma born?

Kyle Kuzma was born on July 24, 1995.

How tall is Kyle Kuzma?

Kyle Kuzma is 6-8 (203 cm) tall.

How much does Kyle Kuzma weigh?

Kyle Kuzma weighs 221 lbs (100 kg).

Is Kyle Kuzma in the Hall of Fame?

Kyle Kuzma is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Kyle Kuzma drafted?

Kyle Kuzma was drafted by Brooklyn Nets, 1st round (27th pick, 27th overall), 2017 NBA Draft.

What position does Kyle Kuzma play?

Power Forward and Small Forward.

What is Kyle Kuzma's net worth?

Kyle Kuzma has made at least $107,085,026 playing professional basketball.

How much does Kyle Kuzma make?

Kyle Kuzma made $25,568,182 in 2024.

How many rings does Kyle Kuzma have?

Kyle Kuzma has won one championship.

What is Kyle Kuzma's Instagram account?

Kyle Kuzma is on Instagram at kuz.

What schools did Kyle Kuzma attend?

Kyle Kuzma attended Rise Academy in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania and Utah.

What are Kyle Kuzma's nicknames?

Kuz is a nickname for Kyle Kuzma.
